summary: Enhance User Engagement - Main Chat Interface
description:
h2. Business Value
I can easily communicate with the AI assistant and keep track of my conversation history.

h2. User Story
As a frequent chat application user, I want a main chat interface with message history and input area so that I can easily communicate with the AI assistant and keep track of my conversation history.

h2. Technical Requirements
* UI:
* Implement a realtime messaging system for chat updates.
* Integrate a database to store and retrieve message history.
* Develop a responsive design to ensure functionality across devices.
* Ensure data encryption for message storage and transmission.
* Implement error handling for failed message sends.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The chat interface displays a scrollable message history that shows past interactions.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The message input area allows users to send text messages to the AI assistant.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The interface supports both text and voice message inputs.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Users can see realtime updates as new messages appear in the chat.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The message history can be searched and filtered for specific entries.
Then the system should respond appropriately

summary: Enhance User Experience - Settings Panel Configuration
description:
h2. Business Value
I can personalize my chat experience in a way that suits my preferences and enhances my interaction with the application.

h2. User Story
As a regular user, I want to customize my language and theme settings so that I can personalize my chat experience in a way that suits my preferences and enhances my interaction with the application.

h2. Technical Requirements
* UI:
* Implement a UI component for the Settings Panel with Language and Theme Settings options.
* Ensure state management for user preferences to persist changes across sessions.
* Integrate with the backend to fetch available languages and themes.
* Optimize the Settings Panel for responsive design on various devices.
* Security:
* Implement security measures to protect user preference data.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Users can access the Settings Panel from the main chat interface.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Users can select and save a preferred language from a list of available options.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Users can choose and apply a theme setting that updates the interface's appearance.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Changes in settings should be reflected immediately without needing to reload the application.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# The application should provide confirmation feedback when settings are saved.
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The Settings Panel should be fully accessible and comply with WCAG standards.
Then the system should respond appropriately

summary: Improve User Efficiency - Quick Actions Toolbar
description:
h2. Business Value
I can easily perform common tasks without navigating away from the main chat interface.

h2. User Story
As a frequent user, I want a Quick Actions toolbar with voice input and file upload options so that I can easily perform common tasks without navigating away from the main chat interface.

h2. Technical Requirements
* UI:
* Develop a modular Quick Actions component with reusable elements.
* Integrate Voice Input Toggle with the existing voice recognition system.
* Ensure File Upload functionality connects to the backend storage system.
* Implement state management to track the status of voice input and file uploads.
* Performance:
* Optimize the toolbar for fast load times and minimal performance impact.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The Quick Actions toolbar is always visible within the main chat interface.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The Voice Input Toggle allows users to switch between text and voice input seamlessly.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The File Upload function enables users to select and send files within the chat without leaving the interface.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The toolbar is accessible via keyboard shortcuts for enhanced usability.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The toolbar is responsive and adapts to different screen sizes without losing functionality.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When All actions within the toolbar provide immediate feedback to confirm user interactions.
Then the system should respond appropriately
